physical_description: Small to modestly sized amphibious people, usually about one to four feet tall, with sinewy limbs, damp protective skin, webbed hands and feet, and often a powerful prehensile tail. Sensory fins or frills can frame the head. Large reflective eyes, color-shifting patterns, and luminous markings permit both speech and visual expression. They can move upright or on four limbs; moisture is essential to their health.
Light sky blue, pale tan or sun-washed gold surfaces adapted to open wet meadows. Legs remain strong for leaping and traversing shallow water.
Moss green, bark brown and lichen gray coloring; fine rootlike patterns help bodies blend into shaded wet woodland.
Peat brown, slate gray and murky green mottling, often with a denser protective skin coating for stagnant wetlands.
Vivid emerald, sapphire or violet skins carrying bright bioluminescent rainlike markings and pronounced sensory frills.
Ocean lineages may be slightly larger, with elongated swimming profiles, reflective seafoam or deep blue skin, and strong tails.
Brilliant reds, turquoise, luminous pink and textured coral-like patterning; fins and webbing support reef-water movement.

Tall, slender, graceful magic-dependent humanoids with features that vary markedly among bloodlines. Skin may range from pale ivory through earth green and brown to deep sapphire. Eyes glow faintly in the color of their affinity, while fine hair can shimmer or float in dense ambient magic. Appearance should communicate personal lineage, not a single uniform skin color.
psionic light in the eyes or temple markings can be an individual appearance cue.
Wetland greens and browns with reed-like markings are characteristic possible looks. The historic text describes woodland and marsh-linked ancestors, but not every detail of this current label.
Luminous pale or violet skin and shifting magical markings are among the approved options for an arcane lineage.
Low-light, shadow-touched coloring and dim luminescence can occur in this bloodline.
Source describes granite, sandstone and muted moonstone coloration, crystalline highlights, and markings reminiscent of stone inscriptions.
Pearlescent aquamarine or tide-blue color and water-adapted accents are approved visual options.

Original Aza'ran draconic people whose living anatomy includes scales, a powerful tail, clawed hands, facial ridges and, where appropriate to lineage, wings. Bodies range from heavy mineral-armored to long and streamlined. Ancient records call these same people Azh’raim; their modern name is Azrahai.
Tall with layered green or blue-green scales, gold and dark speckles, feather-edged aerodynamic wings, and a muscular tail.
Massive, volcanic-adapted build with charcoal or black scales, amber and red accents, broad wings, horns and molten-looking fissures.
Coarse red-green iridescent scales, crystal clusters, dense muscular frame and shorter gliding wings adapted to heat.
Long aquatic body with dark reflective scales, bioluminescent veins, webbed extremities, dorsal fins and swimming-capable wings and tail.
Pale sand-colored crystalline scales, slim limbs and long sail-like wings suited to arid terrain.
Gray, brown and black layered scales with mineral streaks, protective plates, and broad climbing hands and feet.
Dark iridescent scales, semi-translucent patches, silent wings, elongated fingers and a flexible tail.
Deep blue metallic scales, crystal protrusions on shoulders and knuckles, heavy frame and broad flight wings.
Smooth ruby-red and cream scales with radiant crystal edging, long fingers, elegant wings and fine facial ridges.

People whose bodies visibly reflect one of five elemental affinities, rather than a separate generic Elementaris species. Some are solid as stone, some carry ember patterns, others appear fluid, airy or illuminated by magical energy. Their silhouettes and voices may change with the environment; none of those forms should be mistaken for a separate current species.
Bark or stone textured skin, mosslike hair, weighty build, earthy fissures and a deep resonant voice.
Glowing ember veins, heatlike shimmer and hair that can suggest flame; specific color and physiology vary.
Fluid, reflective skin and flowing hair or limbs that resemble currents; water effects need not imply constant liquid anatomy.
Light, wind-swept features and shifting translucency, with clothing or hair that seems moved by unseen breezes.
Luminous magical auras, irregular light patterns and other non-elemental arcane features.

Jaspey are recognized as one people with three established forms, Mosscap, Gloomtail, and Rotcap. Each form has identifiable surface markings or anatomy. Their shared underlying body plan is not specified in the surviving current reference, so no extra height, limb count, or facial anatomy is invented here.
A moss-textured head or crown, with soft green-brown highlights.
A shadow-adapted tail or low-light markings.
Dark fungal or decay-associated patterning.

Tall to towering magical shapeshifters, sometimes feline or beastlike, whose physiques vary from muscular to lithe. Fur, scales or earth-toned skin, reflective eyes, wings, tails or other animal features vary according to the individual's soul bond. No single default animal form applies to every member.
This is an open choice, not a preset wolf, cat or bird subtype. Record the person’s initial appearance and update markings or silhouette only after the true soul bond is established.

Wiry or lithe agile figures, roughly three to six feet tall in the detailed source, with softly luminous skin and shifting freckle-like or sigil markings. Hair can range from honey and copper to chestnut, jade and gold. Eyes may glow subtly when magic is active; layered clothes and charms suit travel and performance.

Dream-born people with forms ranging from tall, shadow-touched silhouettes to luminous figures with weightless hair and shifting auroral features. Their eyes may appear to perceive several layers of reality. Intangibility and visual fluidity vary with magic and should not be assigned as a compulsory permanent body type.

Small, upright, ferret- or stoatlike people with compact wiry bodies, elongated muzzles, expressive eyes, twitching whiskers and opposable thumbs. Fur may be brown, russet, orange, snow white or patterned. Their movement is nimble and acrobatic, and they often carry small belts and handmade tools.

Amphibious aquatic people with dramatic betta-fish coloration: brilliant blues, violets, teals, reds and shifting iridescence. On land they have scaled humanoid legs and arms, bioluminescent jellyfish-like hair, reflective eyes and scales at the face and neck. In water, gills, webbing, dorsal fins and a long caudal fin become prominent. They need hydration and tidal energy.

Infernal magical beings with a humanoid and a quadrupedal equine-inspired form. Humanoid skin can resemble obsidian, molten iron or violet stone, marked by ember veins and living sigils. Curved or bladelike horns, fire-bright or voidlike eyes, varied hair and a prehensile tail distinguish individuals. The equine form adds a muscular horse-like trunk and hooved legs.

Ethereal four-armed people with elongated ear horns, sensitive antennae, iridescent skin and luminous or nebula-like eyes. Hair can look like liquid light, drifting mist or fine feathers. They pass through several lives in service to Nyxarion; during the final life they develop wings. No fixed number of lives is established.

physical_description: Aza'raans are generally tall, slender and graceful, with long limbs and a very pale to slightly tanned complexion. The usual unmixed skin-color range resembles fair to lightly tanned complexions seen among Italian, Slavic and Balkan human populations, without implying any shared Earth ethnic identity. Copper, deep copper, auburn and dark auburn are the most common hair colors. Brown appears sometimes, while black and blonde are rare. Silver, blue and green eyes are common, often with a distinctly oceanic shape, occasionally dual-toned or subtly reflective. High oceanic-style cheekbones, a slightly angular brow with shallow paired ridges, and long ears swept backward are defining traits. Ear tips range from moderately pointed to dramatically sharp and elongated, with individual variation. Some Aza'raans bear faint freckles, subtle psionic luminescence, or wave-like ritual markings. Kaluseban, Deorbasun, Zirramunis, Iamhazira and Gandirosha ancestry can introduce additional color, stature, ear, hair, eye, animal-associated, or magical characteristics; such variation does not redefine the typical unmixed appearance.
